title: The Cold Hangzhou Flat Where Jack Ma Asked His Friends to Start Again
conflicts: The 1999 speech exists in two English renderings (Duncan Clark's translation and the subtitles of Erisman's film); all quotations use Clark's text. Funding: Clark gives a Goldman-led $5m by October 1999, Business Insider adds $20m from SoftBank 'by October 1999' (Wikipedia dates SoftBank to January 2000); the story uses only the Goldman-led $5m. The common '500,000 yuan pooled' figure could not be sourced and is omitted. Headcount: 18 including Ma (Alibaba Group, CNBC), versus CNN's 'with 18 others'.
notes: The exact date 21 February 1999 and the cold/coats details rest on Clark alone and are attributed to him. businessinsider.in pages on the speech are dead and alizila.com is 403, so not cited. Repeat screen flagged the Narayana Murthy Infosys founding edition as 'same-founder' (both founder fields read 'X and N co-founders'); not a real repeat, no field changed. Quote stance: complicates.
